Pteranodon (Animated)
Author: Chistodrako._. (@oscar.lopez.riviello)
Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pteranodon-animated-7d7683df41d1405283f160e81a5dff1b

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Adapted and optimized for Vale Mesozoico VR. Changes include GLB-to-FBX
conversion, removal of non-character helper geometry, texture extraction and
packing, Android ASTC compression, animation selection, culling, scale
normalization, and a custom flight path.
